subject: Request: Pilot window extension for QuickBank - integration blocker
messages:
From: Alex Jordan <alexj@quickbank.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: maya.s@quickbank.com
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: QuickBank pilot - need short extension due to adapter failures

Hi Sergio, Marissa —

QuickBank's engineering team hit a showstopper with the payment adapter during their end-to-end runs this week. The issue is specific to our legacy gateway cert rotation and the adapter in your SDK; until our stack is patched we can't complete the final validation checklist.

We're very close on the functional side, but this is blocking the demo for the execs next week. Can we get a two-week extension to the pilot window and another small sandbox top-up so our engineers can continue troubleshooting without the clock cutting off the environment?

I've attached a short error log from our side and a summary of the reproducer steps. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jordan
Head of Integrations, QuickBank
Attachment: integration-error-log.txt (text/plain)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Jordan <alexj@quickbank.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuickBank pilot - need short extension due to adapter failures

Alex —

Thanks for the quick note and the log. Really sorry you hit this; we appreciate the transparency. I've looped in Sergio (CS lead) and Connor (platform engineer) to assess the severity and give an ETA.

Two asks from our side: 1) can your engs share the minimal reproducer (if different from what you attached) and 2) confirm the names/emails of the execs who need the demo so we can evaluate an interim workaround.

I'll follow up with an internal approval request for a two-week pilot extension and a 25k sandbox credit top-up, but I want engineering to confirm if a short hotfix is possible (we may not need the full extension).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — redwood.ai
From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuickBank pilot - need short extension due to adapter failures

Marissa, Sergio —

Saw Alex's log. Quick read: the reproducer shows the TLS renegotiation during cert rotation drops the connection right after token exchange, which triggers a stale KV cache entry in the adapter shim. We can push a patch to the SDK today that forces a cache invalidation on TLS change; the patch is low-risk and should unblock validation.

Estimated work: 4 engineer-hours to produce the build + 2hrs validation with QuickBank. If they can give us a test window, we can target Monday afternoon for the hotfix and validate before the exec demo.

If for any reason the hotfix slips, I'm fine with recommending the two-week extension.

Connor O'Brien
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Alex Jordan <alexj@quickbank.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuickBank pilot - need short extension due to adapter failures

Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Connor confirms a low-risk hotfix is available and my team can coordinate the validation. Two operational notes: 1) we can provision a 48-hour sandbox extension window to validate the hotfix immediately (no formal credit yet), and 2) if validation shows any lingering regressions we'll approve a two-week pilot extension + 25k sandbox credit as Marissa suggested.

Could you propose a 2-hour slot on Monday or Tuesday next week for the joint test? Also attaching a revised mutual-action-plan (MAP) with proposed sign-off gates.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alex Jordan <alexj@quickbank.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: maya.s@quickbank.com, procurement@quickbank.com
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuickBank pilot - need short extension due to adapter failures

Sergio/Marissa/Connor —

Great news — Connor's hotfix worked in our initial test this morning. We ran the reproducer and the TLS rotation completed without the stale cache hit. Test notes below: 1) hotfix resolved the immediate error, 2) we still need to run a full E2E flow with our reconciliation batch (scheduled for Friday), and 3) the exec demo is still on for next Wednesday but we'd prefer breathing room if the batch uncovers anything.

Given the progress, Procurement asked if Redwood could pre-authorize the two-week extension and the 25k sandbox top-up as a contingency (they want a single PO and terms to cover potential extension activity). If it's possible to pre-approve and we only charge if the extension is used, that would keep the deal moving without paperwork delays.

Can Redwood provide a conditional extension approval (no charge unless used) and a reserved credit hold? If yes, I can route the single PO this afternoon.

Thanks again — really appreciate the responsiveness.
Alex
